articles.title: Using Claude through Google Cloud Vertex AI

blocks.content: The Anthropic Python SDK includes dedicated support for Vertex AI through the `AnthropicVertex` class, which replaces the standard `Anthropic` client when the target is Google Cloud instead of the direct Anthropic API. The rest of the interface (`client.messages.create()`, streaming, tool use) works the same as with the standard client — only authentication and request routing change.

blocks.code:
from anthropic import AnthropicVertex

client = AnthropicVertex(region="global", project_id="your-project-id")
model = "claude-sonnet-4@20250514"

blocks.content: `project_id` is the Google Cloud project ID (visible in the GCP console's project selector), and `region` indicates which Vertex region processes the request. Authentication is resolved through the environment's Google Cloud credentials (ADC), not an Anthropic API key.

subsections.title: Model IDs use a different format

blocks.title: @ + date, not the short name
blocks.content: On the direct Anthropic API, models are identified like this: `claude-sonnet-4-6`. On Vertex AI, the same model is referenced with the format `claude-sonnet-4@20250514` — the model name followed by `@` and that specific version's date. These are distinct IDs for the same model family; they're not interchangeable between platforms.

blocks.title: Not every model is available in every region
blocks.content: Model availability varies by Vertex region. Before locking in a region for production, confirm in the Vertex AI documentation that the chosen model is enabled there.

Claude doesn't generate embeddings (see Claude API → RAG and agentic search → Embeddings and vector search). When the app already runs on Vertex, the most direct option isn't adding an external provider: Google Cloud exposes its own embeddings model, `text-embedding-005`, through the `google-genai` SDK — separate from the `AnthropicVertex` client used for text generation.

blocks.code:
from google import genai

# a different client than AnthropicVertex: this is the Google GenAI SDK
embed_client = genai.Client(project="your-project-id", location="global", vertexai=True)

def generate_embedding(text):
    response = embed_client.models.embed_content(model="text-embedding-005", contents=text)
    return [e.values for e in response.embeddings] if response.embeddings else []

blocks.title: Two SDKs, two purposes
blocks.content: `AnthropicVertex` (Anthropic's SDK) generates text with Claude. `genai.Client` (Google's SDK) generates embeddings with Google's model. They're independent libraries and credentials that coexist in the same app — there's no need to force everything through a single client.
